messages:
Dana: short check-in: final gate for CloudMart marketplace + Atlas SI joint announcement. we have five moving parts: listing content, SI badge/cert, partner quote, embargo + press list, and billing mode. can we commit owners and hard cutoffs?
Oli: i'll own listing content and canonical URLs. will finish metadata and slugs by 5pm PT and upload to sheet.
Min: marketing will produce the 700w blog and landing copy. target draft by Thu 10am PT. need the partner quote by Thu EOD.
Sophie (Design): i'll create hero, mobile crop, and badge (120x40 PNG + SVG). ETA today 4pm PT.
Ravi (SI): SI cert status: integration tests passing except one flaky auth handshake. i'll run extended tests tonight; aim to be green by Fri.
Claire (Legal): embargo suggestion: 2026-05-06 08:00 PT. partners must ACK MSA addendum and quote approvals by Fri COB. otherwise we stagger release.
FinanceBot: partner-managed billing requires tax_id and billing_contact. partners must provide by tomorrow 11am PT to enable that option.
OpsBot: staging push scheduled 2026-05-05 23:00 PT. CI jobs include: schema validation, canonical check, and redirect rules. short TTL on staging recommended.
Dana: runbook snapshot (owners please ack in sheet):
``
RUNBOOK: CloudMart + Atlas SI Final Gate
- Listing metadata + slugs: owner=Oli, due=Today 5pm PT, sheet=Market_SKUs_CM_v2
- Hero + badge assets: owner=Sophie (Design), due=Today 4pm PT, path=drive/marketplace/atlas
- Blog draft + landing: owner=Min, due=Thu 10am PT
- Partner quote signoff: owner=Min+Ravi, partner signoff due=Thu EOD
- SI cert matrix: owner=Ravi, ETA=Fri EOD
- Billing decision (partner-managed vs Redwood): owner=FinanceBot, partner inputs due=Tomorrow 11am PT
- Legal embargo signoff: owner=Claire, partners ACK by Fri COB
- Staging push & preflight: owner=OpsBot, scheduled=2026-05-05 23:00 PT
- Dry run: 30min preflight call 2026-05-06 07:30 PT (ops+infra+partner)
```
Oli: adding redirect plan: will create 301s from promo links and flip after embargo.
Min: CTA question: primary CTA = Request demo for hardware bundles, Start free trial for software-only. agree to default based on SKU type.
Sophie (Design): uploading assets now -> https://drive.redwood/marketplace/atlas (files: hero_final.png, hero_mobile.png, badge_color.png, badge_mono.svg). alt text included.
Ravi (SI): will join dry run with Atlas test lead and bring e2e logs.
Claire (Legal): redline posted to MSA addendum doc; partners must ACK or we remove quotes.
Dana: please update the sheet GO_FLAG and react with :white_check_mark: when your rows are complete. we'll close the thread after the dry run.
